blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Domestic fuel prices will decline this week by more than P7 per liter, following the drop in global oil prices last week. In separate advisories, Jetti Petroleum and Petron Corporation said diesel prices will be rolled back by P7.60 per liter and gasoline prices by P0.30 per liter effective 6 a.m. Tuesday.
